lines.en: label utaarchery1:
scene utadownbad1
: Sensei? When did you get here?
: Somewhere around when you started holding hands with Wakana. I left though since I figured you two probably wanted to be alone.
scene utadownbad2
: Ah...Yeah, I don’t really know how Osako-chan would feel about me stealin’ her girlfriend out from underneath her.
: I’m honestly surprised she even kept that job. I figured it was just a temporary thing while the dojo was stuck in limbo.
scene utadownbad3
: Gotta make that money somehow, Sensei. Osako-chan’s gotten a taste of that sweet nectar and ain’t ever looking back.
: Don’t talk about Osako tasting nectar anywhere near Wakana. She’s already worried I’m going to steal her woman.
: I can hear you, Arakawa.
: See? She’s terrified.
scene utadownbad4
: Are you done being an archer now? Can we go back to being friends?
: Do we always stop being friends whenever I do something for myself?
: Uta, I have extreme social anxiety. We stop being friends whenever I can’t see you.
: Io, the fact that you function at all is something I think we should be proud of.
: I’m not sure if I’d call what I do “functioning,” but I am in an extremely good mood right now, so...what the heck. Sure. Let’s all be proud of me for a minute.
: Just a minute, though. Any longer than that and I will actually die.
scene utadownbad5
: You?...In a good mood?...
: You and Sensei weren’t playing tonsil hockey behind the storage building, were you?
: Even better. He was opening up to me.
: I said literally one thing.
scene utadownbad6
: Hah...it’s like the leaderboard of this harem changes every time I close my eyes.
: Gonna have to break out my notebook when we get back home and see which spot you’re in now, Io.
: You don’t actually have a harem leaderboard, do you?
scene utadownbad7
: Well, what else am I gonna do in class? You don’t make me study anymore.
: I’m like four pages of harem notes away from starting a whole betting ring, Sensei. Do you have any idea how much money there is to be made off of this?
: Am I just a toy to you?
scene utadownbad8
: No. But you are a toy to Uta-chan. And I can swap personas any time I like, Master.
: Marry me.
scene utadownbad9
: What do you think you’re doing, Sensei? Proposing to someone in the bottom ten when you’ve got a higher ranked girl right next to you?
: In his defense, I am definitely not marriage material. In fact, I think even the concept of marriage is archaic and stupid. Why should we have to sign a sheet of paper to prove that we-
scene utadownbad10
: Shush.
: Okay.
: Can I ask who number one in your...weird ranking thing is?
scene utadownbad11
: I mean...you can. I’m just not sure if you want to know the answer.
: Why wouldn’t I want to know the answer?
: Cause it’s Ami.
: Hah...
: See? Even Io’s disappointed in you and she’s your number one fan.
: First off, no one should be disappointed in me when this ranking clearly has nothing to do with-
: Ah-ah-ah. Before you go saying “this ranking has nothing to do with how I treat girls and is based on how much they love me,” it absolutely has everything to do with how you treat us.
: Ami gets more special treatment than anybody.

: Combine that with the fact that she’s also one of the most vocal about her love for you and how you guys go way, way back and you’ve got a combined Uta-chan certified compatibility score of...9.7/10.
: That is way too high of a score for my compatibility with my niece.
scene utadownbad12
: Love comes in all kinds of forms, Sensei.
: Is that why you had a crush on a sponge?
scene utadownbad13
: Don’t bring the sponge into this! That was basically a zillion years ago! My tastes have changed since then! I like humans now!
: Uhh...
: Great! Now Io knows about the sponge! Look what you did!
: I thought Io already knew about the sponge.
: I feel like I know less and less every time you say “sponge.”
scene utadownbad14
: Io! Wakana says you have to come help me clean up the storage room since you sat around all day being worthless.
: What? Since when is that a thing I get punished for?
: Kanda-san, if you call me “Wakana” one more time, I will see to it that you’re removed from this club and sent off to practice kyudo in the sinkhole.
: I think this is your chance, Io.
scene utadownbad15
: But I want to keep hanging out with you and Uta. My day finally became bearable.
: We’ll be here when you get back, Io. I ain’t doing anything today. Sensei and I will just hang out and...
: And I guess that’s it. We’ll just hang out.
: Greenie! Hurry the fuck up! I have shit to do after this!
scene utadownbad16
: Stop calling me that, you incorrigible bimbo! I have a name!
: Yeah but you throw a hissy fit whenever I use that as well. Just get over here and help me clean already.
: Fine. But if you expect me to talk to you while we’re in there, I’m walking right back out.
scene utadownbad17
: I’ll be back, I guess...
: Uhh...yeah. Have fun.
Io wanders off to join Kirin in the shed and, despite my suggestion that she try and befriend her just a short while ago, I have a creeping feeling that that won’t be happening today.
On the bright side, though...she did agree to contributing in some way, which is more than I’d typically expect from her.
Who knows? Maybe she really is so desperate to please me that she’s going to actually start taking a few steps forward?
Or maybe she’s just trying to somehow increase her place in the unofficial harem ranking.
scene utadownbad18
: So, now that you’re alone with Uta-chan (Archer form), what do you wanna do? You ever use a bow before?
: Do I look like the type of guy who has used a bow before?
: No. But you look like the type of guy who’s about to.
: What?
scene black
: Come on! Take this! I’ll show you how it’s done!
: I’m not as good of a teacher as Miss Watabe, but if you’re gonna learn this from anybody else, I’m probably the one you wanna come to!
Uta hands me the bow (Which I have no idea how to hold properly) before grabbing my waist and redirecting me toward the targets at the far end of the range.
That part I probably could have figured out on my own, but I’m not about to deny any amount of physical contact from Uta-chan.
scene utadownbad19
This level of physical contact is not what I expected, though.
Instead of coaching me from the sidelines or nearby like I expected her to, Uta takes her place directly behind me and rests her hands on my arm and my wrist respectively.
Her chestguard presses up against my back and robs me of a sensation I have longed for, but my imagination does its job and fills in the blanks for me so I don’t miss out entirely.
Then, from what feels like miles below, a bright and joyous voice with a mild rasp to it cuts through the air, crawls up my back, and nests in my ears.
: Don’t pay any attention to me, okay? Just straighten out your limbs and try to stand up straight.
: Also, please don’t let go of the string. I don’t want it to snap back and break all of my fingers off.
: You’re sure asking a lot out of a first-timer, huh?
: Yeah, but only cause I think you’d be pretty good at this with some practice.
scene utadownbad20
: Your body’s kinda huge, Sensei. And your figure is great too.
: If a girl my size is able to handle a bow as well as I can, just imagine how the snap will sound when you launch your arrow.
: I’d say we should find out, but I think you said something about wanting to keep your fingers.
: That is correct. Updating my harem ranking will be hard if I can’t write anymore.
: Also, don’t get cocky thinking your shot will echo across the range on the first try. There’s a lot more to kyudo than raw power. That’s only a tiny part of it.
: I’m just saying it could sound beautiful one day. And that you might be great at this if you keep practicing.
: I’m open to practicing as much as you want so long as we can always do it like this.
scene utadownbad21
: What’s wrong?
scene utadownbad22
: Uta?
: We can practice whenever you want.
: I get that. But you’re-
: I’m just making sure your posture stays good. You can keep ignoring me.
scene utadownbad23
: I think that might be a little easier said than done.
: I’d say I’m happy to hear that, but that would basically be the same thing as admitting that-
: What are you guys doing?
scene utadownbad24
: UHH! NOTHING! ARCHERY! POSTURE!
: JUST...HELPING SENSEI WITH HIS FORM!
: Cool, but...why are you yelling?
: Because I’m...in the zone?
: Huh. Well, I’m done for now if you guys want to-
: Actually! Uhh...I have to talk to Sensei about something he just told me!
scene utadownbad25
: You do?
: SHH! She saw me hugging you! Act sad.
: But I-
: Sensei! Please!
scene utadownbad26
: I’m sad and I need Uta’s help for some reason.
: S-See?! The poor guy’s basically in tatters! But give me a few minutes with him and I’ll whip him right back into shape for you, Io!
: For me? Why would that be for me? If Sensei’s actually feeling down, shouldn’t you be doing that for him?
: That’s...yes! That’s what I meant! But you are also here, so...when I return, you will also reap the benefits of...his happiness!
scene utadownbad27
: You’re acting really weird right now.
: I just...
: I feel really...bad for him...because of the sad thing he told me...
: It really is sad.
: Just start walking away. She’ll wait.
: I’m going to start walking away now.
scene utadownbad28
: We’ll be back in a few minutes, Io! Don’t...go anywhere!
: I sure hope I don’t stay sad any longer.
: Give it a break, Sensei! Your acting sucks!
: What the heck just happened?
scene black
scene utadownbad29
: (Screaming internally)
: I feel like you could have handled that a little better.
: Yeah, you’re one to talk with all of that “I’m so sad! Woe is me!” crap! Those acting chops wouldn’t last you one minute in a maid cafe!
scene utadownbad30
: Hey, you sucked too. I’m starting to think you get your powers from the uniform.
: It definitely helps!
: So, are you going to tell me why you pulled me into this-
scene utadownbad31
: Wait...where even are we?
: The tea ceremony room.
: We have a tea ceremony room?
: We have a whole tea ceremony club. They just happen to use one of the buildings near the archery range since this is where they keep all the...old school stuff, I guess.
: Okay, but then...why exactly did you pull me into the tea ceremony room?
scene utadownbad29
: I have no idea! It just happened!
: At first, it was probably because I didn’t want Io to think anything suspicious was going on, but now I realize that this just makes everything look even more suspicious!
: Then...should we go back out there?
: No! Because coming in here for just one minute would make everything even more suspicious!
scene utadownbad32
: You really dug yourself into a hole this time, didn’t you?
: Ahhhh! What am I doing, Sensei?!
: You’re being suspicious as hell, that’s what.
scene utadownbad33
: Or...wait. I think the word is “sus” now. I’ve been hearing the other girls say that lately.
: Okay. I need to sit down.
scene black
Uta takes her shoes off and sits down on the tatami mat, pulling her knees up to her chest and gently rocking back and forth as I lower myself to meet her.
It’s clear that, for some reason, this spur of the moment decision has already turned into spur of the moment regret, but that doesn’t mean we can’t figure out some way to enjoy it.
Especially since her best friend is probably still standing exactly where we left her and attempting to wrap her head around everything currently going on.
But hey, that’s fine. Because I’m doing the exact same thing.
scene utadownbad34
Or, at least that’s what I was doing before finally getting to look at Uta’s face- which is currently redder than I have ever seen it before.
: You just wanted to be alone with me for a little while longer, didn’t you?
: Wh...What makes you think that?
: The face. The rocking back and forth. The nervous poke war your index fingers are having with one another right now.
: I’m just...really nervous around tea.
: You know, you’ve said a lot of questionable things over the brief time I’ve known you, but that one really makes me question just what type of person you are, Uta.
scene utadownbad35
: I’m...not good at thinking things through, okay?! My whole life is a series of weird, impulsive decisions! This is just the first time you’ve gotten wrapped up in one.
: There was also the one time in-
: The karaoke collision was an accident! Not an impulse!
: Was almost kissing me after the collision an accident too?
: Nope! Because that part never happened and it’s all one big fantasy you dreamt up!
: Ahh, okay. Just making sure.
: For the record, though- I don’t really think being impulsive always has to be a bad thing. I like being alone with you. Just...probably not when Io is also expecting to be here.
scene utadownbad36
: AAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHH!
: Uta, chill. It’s really not a big deal.
: Io knows all about you, right? Because, if that’s the case, explaining to her that you just impulsively dragged me in here should fix pretty much every misunderstanding you’re worried about.
: It’s because she knows me so well that I’m worried, Sensei! I’m only like this under very specific circumstances!
: And those circumstances are?
scene utadownbad37
: Circumstances I must be very careful with.
: And why is-
: Because I don’t want them to get me in trouble.
: And because I’m...
scene utadownbad38
: I’m afraid it might happen again...
: Afraid that...what might happen again?
scene utadownbad39
: You mind just giving me a minute to catch my breath and...not make any more impulsive decisions? Cause I’ve only made one so far and even that’s got the potential to flip my life on its head.
: I still think you might be overthinking this. I’m pretty sure Io will understand.
: I might be using the word wrong, but I’m pretty sure that would be ironic.
: How come?
: Because my history of not thinking about things is the only reason I ever met Io in the first place.
scene black
When we leave the tea ceremony room, we find Io crouched over the body of a dead caterpillar- slowly allowing dirt to sift through her fingers and cover it up.
She hosts a makeshift funeral for the bug with Uta and I as guests...and doesn’t once question where we disappeared to.
She’s too happy to have us back.
$ utaarchery1 = True
$ uta_love += 1
Uta’s affection has increased to [uta_love]!
jump saturdayafternoon
